summary: A fault snapshot reads in one cut and reads each run, step, declaration and failure claim that its failures share once, instead of once per failure and per reader

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. The faults, their owners and their order are unchanged; the families that were read in separate cuts now share one, so a write that lands while a snapshot runs is seen by all of them or none.

recovery.detail: An older build reads the same faults with more statements.
